jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary

The Creative Director is a marketing leadership role responsible for the creative vision, concept development, and campaign quality of athenahealth's marketing work. This leader originates and shapes big creative ideas, from campaign concepts through major brand moments, and builds a creative team capable of consistently delivering work at that level.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Creative & Content, this role partners closely with teams across Marketing to develop creative concepts and campaigns. This role also works closely with the Head of Creative and Content Operations, and with the Director, Content Hub & Studio, to ensure creative concepts are grounded in production reality and move effectively through the studio.

This position requires a strong creative point of view, the ability to develop and pitch big ideas to senior stakeholders, and the leadership skills to build and grow a team of creative talent. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading creative for B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex marketing organizations, along with experience building and developing creative teams.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Develop original creative concepts for major campaigns, brand initiatives, and cross channel marketing moments, working from strategic and messaging directions set by Brand and Editorial & Content Strategy.
Pitch and defend creative concepts to senior marketing leadership and other stakeholders, building consensus around a strong creative direction.
Set the overall creative vision for how athenahealth shows up in market, ensuring big ideas are distinctive, on brand, and effective.
Partner with stakeholders early in the planning process so creative concepts are grounded in strategy from the start.
Push the team to develop bolder, more ambitious creative rather than defaulting to safe or expected ideas.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creative talent, including designers, copywriters, and other creative staff, building their range and ambition as creative thinkers.
Recruit and develop creative talent, building a team capable of generating strong concept work consistently.
Create a culture where creative risk taking is encouraged and where the team is pushed to do their best conceptual work.
Provide creative feedback and direction that helps individual team members grow, not just improves the immediate deliverable.
Establish creative development opportunities, including exposure to new tools, techniques, and outside inspiration, to keep the team's thinking fresh.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Serve as the primary creative voice in planning conversations with Brand, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Segment, and Customer Marketing.
Work closely with the Head of Creative and Content Operations to align creative ambition with production capacity, timelines, and resourcing, and to ensure operational realities are considered early in concept development.
Partner with Brand to ensure creative concepts express brand identity in ways that feel fresh and distinctive, not just compliant.
Champion creative excellence as a standard across the marketing organization, advocating for the resources and time needed to develop strong concepts.
Stay current on creative trends, tools, and techniques relevant to B2B marketing and healthcare technology, bringing new thinking into the team.

Expected Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Design, Fine Arts, Communications, or a related field required.
10+ years of progressive experience in creative roles, including concept development, art direction, or copywriting, with a strong portfolio of creative work.
At least 5 years in a creative leadership role managing and developing other creative talent.
Proven track record developing and pitching big creative concepts that were adopted and executed at an enterprise scale.
Experience in B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
Strong, distinctive creative point of view, with the ability to generate original concepts rather than iterating existing ideas.
Ability to pitch and defend creative work persuasively to senior stakeholders, including pushback and negotiation on creative direction.
Skilled at balancing creative ambition with brand guardrails and business objectives.
Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor, and grow creative talent, with a track record of developing people into stronger creative thinkers.
Experience building a creative team culture that supports experimentation and high-quality conceptual work.
Strong feedback and coaching skills, with the ability to give creative direction that develops people over time.
Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to bring stakeholders along on a creative vision.
Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization where creative vision must align with strategy, production capacity, and business goals.

Expected Compensation

$137,000 - $233,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About Athenahealth

Our vision:
In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:
Our talented    employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:
Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative    workspaces   — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,   full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth   enables   employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal-opportunity

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description:
Agency

Golin Ketchum

Job Function

Creative

Job Subfunction

Creative Direction

Job Description

Associate Creative Director

Golin Ketchum is looking for an Associate Creative Director who's just as obsessed with a scroll-stopping Instagram Reel as they are with an idea built to break the internet.

This role has two jobs, not one. Some days you're deep in owned social — building out share-worthy content across a large portfolio of fun brands, writing captions with actual voice, and turning a brand's day-to-day social presence into something people choose to follow. Other days you're dreaming up the big, loud, culture-jacking tentpole moment that gets Buzzfeed, Complex, and Hypebeast calling us instead of the other way around.

You're not choosing between "always-on" and "big swing." You're doing both, for some of the most beloved brands on shelf.

About Golin Ketchum

Golin Ketchum is the most awarded public relations agency of the decade. We create change that matters for our clients and our people. The kind of change that earns attention and shapes culture to build business.

Formed in 2026 from the merger of two iconic PR agencies, Golin Ketchum combines fearless creative and strategic excellence, fueled by Omnicom’s industry-leading data and AI solutions, to uncover powerful insights and execute work that builds and protects the world’s greatest companies.

With specialized expertise across consumer and brands, corporate affairs, healthcare, technology, and food, agriculture and nutrition, we deliver integrated, high-impact communications services at scale.

At Golin Ketchum, culture matters. We are fiercely ambitious yet fundamentally kind and collaborate obsessively with the best clients in the world.

Want to create change that matters with us? Here are the details:

What You’ll Do

Build always-on social content and campaigns that make the brands' social channels feel alive — not just a media plan with captions bolted on
Develop the bigger earned-first ideas — tentpole moments, real-time opportunities, stunts — designed to travel beyond the brand's own channels
Partner with the PR media team to turn your ideas into actual headlines, not just decks
Work channel-agnostic, but know social platform craft cold — what a TikTok needs is not what a press release needs, and you should never confuse the two
Communicate your ideas to the clients with clarity, strategic insight and passion
Hunt for and share out with the rest of the team what’s breaking in culture BEFORE it breaks in culture
Build a portfolio that proves you can do both the quiet, consistent work and the loud, ownable swing
Proactive thinking. You’re always bringing ideas because you know not every opportunity lives within the brief

You'll know you're doing it right when the brand's Instagram comments are as good as the news coverage. Our approach has helped us win Cannes Lions and back-to-back PRWEEK Global Agency of the Year — for ideas built for the feed and ideas built for the front page.

What You Have

5-8 years’ experience in advertising, social, or digital media. Knowledge of earned media is a plus.
109% internet fluency. You know the ins and outs of social media, speak the language of the internet, have gone down YouTube rabbit holes for multiple hours in a row, have uploaded multiple TikTok videos and have explored without fear the inner depths of Reddit.
Art Director: You’re a wizard in Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator and have an understanding of visual storytelling.
Writer: You’re a wizard at using words to communicate emotion and inciting people to hit that share button.
You’re a genuinely nice person who brings energy every single day to your work and to the agency.

Golin Ketchum is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Golin Ketchum recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, protected veteran status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status or citizenship status.

130k-165k

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice

For US Job Seekers

It is the policy of Omnicom and any of its affiliates to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law. EOE/AA/M/D/V/F.

jobs.title: Audience & Content Strategy Director, Filene (WI, TX, or CO)
jobs.description:
The Audience & Content Strategy Director serves as Filene’s senior brand, audience, and content leader, responsible for transforming enterprise marketing, audience growth, and digital engagement strategies into audience-centered, multi-channel content experiences that drive awareness, engagement, influence, and measurable business outcomes.

This is both a strategy and execution role. As a small, highly collaborative organization, Filene needs a leader who is equally comfortable setting the strategy and personally bringing it to life. This Director will move fluidly between developing audience and channel strategies, shaping Filene’s brand and editorial direction, writing and editing content, managing Filene’s social media presence, optimizing digital content, analyzing performance, and coordinating execution across internal and external partners.

This role develops and operationalizes Filene’s content strategy and optimization approach, multi-channel strategy, audience and role-based segmentation framework, messaging framework, thought leadership platform, social media strategy, content discovery optimization efforts, and performance measurement framework. Working across Marketing, Membership, Research, Innovation, Advisory Services, and Product teams, this leader ensures content investments and channel strategy & messaging align with organizational priorities and effectively engage audiences throughout the member lifecycle.

Serving as Filene’s editor-in-chief and chief content strategist, the Director also establishes the governance, frameworks, member feedback loops, Filene collaboration models and tech stack needs to ensure content messaging quality, consistency, discoverability, and business impact while reinforcing Filene’s position as a leading voice in cooperative finance and financial well-being. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports; the Director leads through influence, driving alignment and outcomes across teams. Success requires both strategic leadership and hands-on execution. The Director personally owns key channels and deliverables while leveraging cross-functional partners, agencies, freelancers, and technology to extend Filene’s capacity and impact.

The Creative Director is a marketing leadership role responsible for the creative vision, concept development, and campaign quality of athenahealth's marketing work. This leader originates and shapes big creative ideas, from campaign concepts through major brand moments, and builds a creative team capable of consistently delivering work at that level.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Creative & Content, this role partners closely with teams across Marketing to develop creative concepts and campaigns. This role also works closely with the Head of Creative and Content Operations, and with the Director, Content Hub & Studio, to ensure creative concepts are grounded in production reality and move effectively through the studio.

This position requires a strong creative point of view, the ability to develop and pitch big ideas to senior stakeholders, and the leadership skills to build and grow a team of creative talent. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading creative for B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex marketing organizations, along with experience building and developing creative teams.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Develop original creative concepts for major campaigns, brand initiatives, and cross channel marketing moments, working from strategic and messaging directions set by Brand and Editorial & Content Strategy.
Pitch and defend creative concepts to senior marketing leadership and other stakeholders, building consensus around a strong creative direction.
Set the overall creative vision for how athenahealth shows up in market, ensuring big ideas are distinctive, on brand, and effective.
Partner with stakeholders early in the planning process so creative concepts are grounded in strategy from the start.
Push the team to develop bolder, more ambitious creative rather than defaulting to safe or expected ideas.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creative talent, including designers, copywriters, and other creative staff, building their range and ambition as creative thinkers.
Recruit and develop creative talent, building a team capable of generating strong concept work consistently.
Create a culture where creative risk taking is encouraged and where the team is pushed to do their best conceptual work.
Provide creative feedback and direction that helps individual team members grow, not just improves the immediate deliverable.
Establish creative development opportunities, including exposure to new tools, techniques, and outside inspiration, to keep the team's thinking fresh.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Serve as the primary creative voice in planning conversations with Brand, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Segment, and Customer Marketing.
Work closely with the Head of Creative and Content Operations to align creative ambition with production capacity, timelines, and resourcing, and to ensure operational realities are considered early in concept development.
Partner with Brand to ensure creative concepts express brand identity in ways that feel fresh and distinctive, not just compliant.
Champion creative excellence as a standard across the marketing organization, advocating for the resources and time needed to develop strong concepts.
Stay current on creative trends, tools, and techniques relevant to B2B marketing and healthcare technology, bringing new thinking into the team.

Expected Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Design, Fine Arts, Communications, or a related field required.
10+ years of progressive experience in creative roles, including concept development, art direction, or copywriting, with a strong portfolio of creative work.
At least 5 years in a creative leadership role managing and developing other creative talent.
Proven track record developing and pitching big creative concepts that were adopted and executed at an enterprise scale.
Experience in B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
Strong, distinctive creative point of view, with the ability to generate original concepts rather than iterating existing ideas.
Ability to pitch and defend creative work persuasively to senior stakeholders, including pushback and negotiation on creative direction.
Skilled at balancing creative ambition with brand guardrails and business objectives.
Demonstrated ability to recruit, mentor, and grow creative talent, with a track record of developing people into stronger creative thinkers.
Experience building a creative team culture that supports experimentation and high-quality conceptual work.
Strong feedback and coaching skills, with the ability to give creative direction that develops people over time.
Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to bring stakeholders along on a creative vision.
Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization where creative vision must align with strategy, production capacity, and business goals.

Expected Compensation

$137,000 - $233,000

new_jobs.title: Audience & Content Strategy Director, Filene (WI, TX, or CO)
new_jobs.description:
The Audience & Content Strategy Director serves as Filene’s senior brand, audience, and content leader, responsible for transforming enterprise marketing, audience growth, and digital engagement strategies into audience-centered, multi-channel content experiences that drive awareness, engagement, influence, and measurable business outcomes.

This is both a strategy and execution role. As a small, highly collaborative organization, Filene needs a leader who is equally comfortable setting the strategy and personally bringing it to life. This Director will move fluidly between developing audience and channel strategies, shaping Filene’s brand and editorial direction, writing and editing content, managing Filene’s social media presence, optimizing digital content, analyzing performance, and coordinating execution across internal and external partners.

This role develops and operationalizes Filene’s content strategy and optimization approach, multi-channel strategy, audience and role-based segmentation framework, messaging framework, thought leadership platform, social media strategy, content discovery optimization efforts, and performance measurement framework. Working across Marketing, Membership, Research, Innovation, Advisory Services, and Product teams, this leader ensures content investments and channel strategy & messaging align with organizational priorities and effectively engage audiences throughout the member lifecycle.

Serving as Filene’s editor-in-chief and chief content strategist, the Director also establishes the governance, frameworks, member feedback loops, Filene collaboration models and tech stack needs to ensure content messaging quality, consistency, discoverability, and business impact while reinforcing Filene’s position as a leading voice in cooperative finance and financial well-being. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports; the Director leads through influence, driving alignment and outcomes across teams. Success requires both strategic leadership and hands-on execution. The Director personally owns key channels and deliverables while leveraging cross-functional partners, agencies, freelancers, and technology to extend Filene’s capacity and impact.
